newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK OKAYS TAURO BANK'S STATUTE CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK OKAYS TAURO BANK'S STATUTE CHANGE.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Thursday that its weekly board meeting had approved changes in Tauro bank's statutes, paving the way for it to become a public company with a listing on the bourse.
"The Bank of Lithuania's board agreed to Tauro Bank's reoranisation into a public company and registered its new stautute," the central bank said in a statement.
Tauro Bank is a medium sized bank with 36 million litas in share capital. It had a net profit of 10.6 million litas last year.
The bank decided during its last shareholders' meeting to change its statutes and become a public company.
It also decided to boost its share capital to 76 million litas with a 40 million litas issue.
